rules.probability: predicted risks are finite and within [0, 1]
rules.horizon: risk does not fall as the horizon lengthens (36 <= 60 <= 120 months)
rules.T: risk does not fall as pT rises, other inputs fixed
rules.N: risk does not fall as pN rises, other inputs fixed
rules.age: from age 45 risk does not fall with age, other inputs fixed
rules.hr: hazard ratio against the reference profile stays within 1/50 to 50

advisory.unknown: an unknown receptor status gives a risk between its positive and negative values

H1.title: Binary labels misstate mortality when follow-up is short
H1.headline: In TCGA (median follow-up 30 months, 56% of patients with unknown 36-month status) censored-as-alive gives 3.8% against a Kaplan-Meier 6.1% at 36 months (bias -2.3 points, 95% CI -3.3 to -1.5); dropping censored patients gives 8.6%. At 60 months: 5.9% and 20.8% against 12.8%. In METABRIC the 36-month bias is -0.15 points.

H2.title: Discrimination transports; calibration-in-the-large does not
H2.headline: Held-out Uno C 0.693 (95% CI 0.654-0.731; prediction interval 0.621-0.764). Calibration slope 0.94 (prediction interval 0.68-1.20). Observed/expected 36-month mortality pools to 1.03 but varies from site to site: I-squared 81%, prediction interval 0.40-2.66.

H3.title: Re-estimating one scalar locally reduces calibration error
H3.headline: With 100 local patients the 36-month error fell in TCGA, M2 (TCGA 5.8 to 2.7 points; M2 3.9 to 2.7 points) and rose in M1, M3, M4, M5, where the transported model was already close (M1 1.0 to 2.8; M3 1.7 to 2.1; M4 1.5 to 2.6; M5 2.5 to 4.3). The estimate is noisy because only a handful of deaths occur by 36 months in 100 patients.

H4.title: Passport verdicts identify where calibration fails
H4.headline: Absolute calibration gap in ABSTAIN minus SHOW groups: 2.0 points (permutation p = 0.40); CAUTION minus SHOW: 0.5 points (p = 0.81). The verdicts describe how much evidence exists, not where the model is wrong.

H5.title: A risk threshold chosen on other sites keeps false reassurance within 5%
H5.headline: Observed 36-month mortality among reassured patients was at or below 5% in 5 of 6 held-out sites (range 0.0-5.9%), with coverage 21-62%. With the minimum set size fixed in the plan (100 patients) no threshold could be certified in 4 of 6 folds.
